intro: Five programs, one promise: every contribution helps a child build a brighter future. Pick the one closest to your heart and follow its progress here.

programs.title: Education for Every Child
programs.description: We pay school fees, supply books and uniforms, and fund teachers in villages where the nearest classroom is hours away.

image.alt: Children studying at a school desk

programs.title: Child Healthcare
programs.description: Mobile clinics bring doctors, vaccines and basic medicine to children who cannot easily reach a hospital.

programs.title: Clean Water for All
programs.description: We build wells and install water filtration points near schools, so children can spend more time learning instead of fetching water.

image.alt: Children drinking clean water from a tap

programs.title: Nutrition for Children
programs.description: We provide nutritious meals, food supplies and nutrition education to help children grow stronger, stay healthy and focus on their education.

programs.title: Safe Shelter for Every Child
programs.description: We support vulnerable children and families with safe shelter, essential supplies and access to community support services.

image.alt: Children spending time in a safe community space
